props.text: A commit is a saved snapshot of the staged files, with a message and a parent.
A branch is a movable name that points at one commit.
New commits move the current branch forward; other branches stay put.
git fetch downloads commits; git pull is fetch followed by a merge.
Revert, not reset, undoes a commit that is already pushed.
